blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 174 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 10, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MRNA lead 174 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 30 Canadian and 144 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 10, 2026) found 174 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 30 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 14 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +99% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 6 names.

In the U.S., 144 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 64 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +416% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 39 names.
